scope: Matched exit intervention on the 4396 archived executed entries; not candidate selection or a portfolio backtest.
unique_change: Replace MA20 downward-cross exit with first post-entry completed close below the fixed original entry-signal pivot. Each entry has its own state.
horizon: Archived 40-valid-bar endpoint of each original entry, identical across arms.
execution: Reuse BacktestEngine independent matcher, T+1, original prices, tradability and one-price limits; frozen commission 0.0003, slippage 10 bps, a_share_historical sell tax. No stops, profit locks or max-hold overrides.
terminal_accounting: Matcher end records are censored, not strategy exits. Mark open shares at endpoint close after entry costs without a hypothetical sell fee. Executed exits use net proceeds held as zero-interest cash to the same endpoint. Include pending unsellable positions as censored.
benchmark: Archived equal-weight market gross return over the same fixed horizon. Report geometric excess wealth; paired difference is pivot excess minus MA20 excess.
statistics: 2000 circular moving-block bootstrap replicates on the complete training signal-date trading calendar, block length 60 trading days, seed 20260910. Resample day sums and counts jointly, retaining all same-day cross-sectional events. Centered two-sided bootstrap p-value. Exploratory family exposure remains disclosed; this is not independent confirmation.
required_outputs: both arms per-event records and censor counts
all gates and one next action
decision: All gates are needed for research support of the exit intervention; failure stops this representation and neighboring buffer/MA-window tuning. Candidate selection remains unsupported even if exit intervention passes.
